data.exact_reserve_text: A surplus run-off amount of GBP 18.1m was experienced in 2017 (2016: GBP 8.6m deficit). This was made up of a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 22.5m on direct business (2016: GBP 14.1m deficit) and a GBP 4.4m deficit on reinsurance accepted business (2016: GBP 5.5m surplus).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net prior-year reserve release in 2017 of GBP 18.1m (approximately 6.6% of opening gross claims reserves). This net release comprised a GBP 22.5m favourable movement on prior-year direct business reserves partially offset by a GBP 4.4m adverse movement on reinsurance-accepted (treaty) business.
